# Model card: alert-tp-classifier v1.0.0

*Generated by `05_ml/train.py` (seed 1337). Do not hand-edit numbers; re-run the script.*

## Intended use
Estimate P(true positive) for a SOC alert so the triage queue can be **re-ranked**. The score is one
input to risk fusion. It is **never** treated as logical proof, and it can't trigger disruptive actions
by itself. Containment still needs an ENTAILED justification plus human approval.

## Out of scope
Disciplinary or HR decisions about users, automated containment, and real (non-synthetic) telemetry
until it has been revalidated.

## Data
Synthetic alerts from `src/sim/generator.py` (n=4000, positive rate 0.31),
stratified split {'train': 2399, 'val': 800, 'test': 801}. Features: severity, criticality, ioc_match, ioc_confidence, failed_logins, success_after_fail, impossible_travel, edr_source, off_hours, privileged_user, asset_alert_count, cls_credential, cls_execution, cls_recon, cls_lateral, cls_exfil.
Protected attributes (`region`, `department`) are **excluded** from features and used only for the audit.

## Selection
Selected model: **mlp**. Rule: highest validation ROC-AUC (3 d.p.), ties broken by lower ECE; numpy-exportable only.
5-fold CV ROC-AUC on train: logistic 0.973 ± 0.009;
MLP 0.966 ± 0.008.

## Fairness (false-positive rate by user region, threshold 0.5)
- symbolic rules: {'APAC': 0.0148, 'EU': 0.019, 'LATAM': 0.0, 'NA': 0.0135} (gap 0.019)
- mlp: {'APAC': 0.0667, 'EU': 0.0696, 'LATAM': 0.0696, 'NA': 0.027} (gap 0.043)
- Threshold 0.1: **PASS**. The generator injects benign APAC VPN
  impossible-travel noise, so the impossible_travel feature is the main disparity risk. Monitor it in production.

## Learning case (demo scenario 6)
- precision@80 on held-out alerts (analyst queue top 10%): rules only 0.938, rules + ML 0.975. Improves: **True**
- RL advisor reward vs rule policy: Q-learning 3.55 vs rules 1.48
  (improves: **True**). Unsafe action rate 0.000 (masked actions).
- Guardrails: fairness gap ok = True; ML cannot trigger disruptive actions.

## Limitations
The model is trained only on synthetic distributions and has no concept drift handling. Labels come from
the generator rather than analyst ground truth, and the calibration holds only for this distribution.
Revalidate against labelled production data before any real use.
